name: myCred Toolkit
author: myCred

sections.description:
The myCred toolkit is a comprehensive package of myCred add-ons designed to enhance your website’s gamification efforts significantly.

It offers a variety of features and functionalities that help you engage users, reward their activities, and create a more interactive and enjoyable user experience.

Whether you’re looking to implement points systems, leaderboards, or achievement badges, the myCred toolkit provides the tools you need to make your website more dynamic and engaging.

short_description: The myCred Toolkit is a powerful add-on, designed to enhance user engagement by offering additional tools and addons.
